name: Local default
description: Default local installation with no enterprise policy overrides; exact OS/runtime recorded by future test runs.

name: Hosted default
description: Default hosted surface at the observation timestamp; plan and tenant policy recorded separately.

name: Enterprise managed
description: Managed tenant with administrator policy gates explicitly captured as qualifiers.

name: Preview enabled
description: Surface with a documented preview/experimental feature switch enabled.

name: Air-gapped/restricted network
description: Restricted network profile; useful for local transports, registries and OAuth constraints.
